description: Land Acquisition - Naotunna, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District - Keraminiya, Ambalangoda D/S Division, Galle District - Galigamuwa, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1924/39 of 23.07.2015 by Panwila D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land plots, their locations, extents, and ownership details, along with procedures for compensation claims. This falls squarely under the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land acquisition and property matters.
